scope: Two-client TPC-C improvement only; sysbench declined and the eight-client comparison is incomplete
changes: Shared primary-key batch binding for planning and pre-locking with returned values, including missing keys under repeatable read
Retain transaction isolation and bind prelock keys after catalog refresh and implicit transaction activation
Normal pessimistic prewrite recovery without an environment switch
TTL-capped TxnLock backoff with a time budget instead of full-TTL sleep and four-attempt refusal
Cancellable wait helper owns absolute-deadline clamping
build: cd rust && cargo build --offline --locked --release -j12 -p tidb-server --bin tidb-server

sysbench.conclusion: After is slower in every paired round, with a roughly 1.97 percent lower median. No speedup; investigate a possible regression. No builds, profiling, or other workloads overlapped the measurement.
sysbench.command: python3 rust/scripts/compare-sysbench.py --server before:53009 --server after:53010 --server go:45000 --database perf_sysbench_locking_v2 --workload oltp_read_write --threads 2 --seconds 20 --rounds 3 --table-size 100000 --output /private/tmp/tidb-batch-sysbench-comparison

correctness.live_sql_reference: Go TiDB 45000 and Rust 53010 agree on selected and final rows, RR absent-key exclusion, RC absent-key admission, transaction-retained isolation and first autocommit=0 statement
correctness.scope_limits: Not full read-committed snapshot, partition or wait-policy coverage; Ready/lint not run

tpcc.status: Two-client comparison complete; eight-client round 3 stopped on an old-build deadlock

two_clients.conclusion: All three paired rounds improve; the median gain is approximately 9.90 percent. This is a scoped two-client result, not the full performance objective.

eight_clients.failure: Old-build round 3 returned Error 1213 during UPDATE stock; its sample was rejected and after round 3 was not run
eight_clients.conclusion: No gain established: after is slower in both complete pairs, and the full three-round comparison is incomplete.

tpcc.validation: 160000 transactions in valid measured samples and 6000 warmups; failed old-build sample retained separately. All 11 Go post-run checks pass and all 30000 customers have zero balance or delivery-counter mismatches.
tpcc.measurement_limits: Shared evolving dataset and time-seeded tool RNG; no builds, profiling or other workloads overlapped the comparison
